rationale: No spec was present (compact profile, no story artifact); confidence is low. Two major defects confirmed reachable: active spinner intervals are never cancelled when renderSteps re-renders (leak to detached nodes), and showApproval re-entry after stampApproval leaves orphaned no-op buttons. Three candidates dismissed: setInterval is natively available in Node.js and the test file deliberately avoids startSpinner; the insertSubStep silent-drop path is task-specified intentional behavior documented in code comments; stepsById dead-map allocation is below the emission floor.

findings.title: Active spinner intervals leak on renderSteps re-render
findings.problem: renderSteps clears the rows Map and resets container.innerHTML but never iterates spinners or calls clearInterval. After re-render the spinners Map still holds live interval handles that continue writing to detached DOM nodes indefinitely.
findings.impact: Every re-render while at least one step is ACTIVE leaks a setInterval handle. In a long-running install session with multiple renderSteps calls (e.g. phase transitions) this accumulates unbounded callbacks and prevents GC of the orphaned nodes.
findings.recommendation: At the top of renderSteps, before rows.clear() and the innerHTML reset, iterate spinners: `spinners.forEach((t) => clearInterval(t)); spinners.clear();`

findings.title: showApproval re-entry after stamp adds orphaned no-op buttons
findings.problem: showApproval removes any existing .approval element and always appends a new approval bar, but does not guard against being called after stampApproval has already written a .stamp element. A second call appends approval buttons alongside the existing stamp.
findings.impact: The redundant buttons are permanently visible but are no-ops on click (stampApproval has its own early-return guard against double-stamp). The UI presents a confusing approved-yet-actionable state that cannot be dismissed without a full re-render.
findings.recommendation: Add an early-return guard at the start of showApproval after the rec null-check: `if (rec.main.querySelector('.stamp')) return;`
